item.title: HARRY POTTER TV Series Will Be "The Streaming Event Of The Decade" According To HBO Exec
item.description: Excitement is already high for HBO's upcoming Harry Potter TV series, and one executive is billing the series as "the biggest streaming event in the history of HBO Max."

item.title: Upcoming Marvel Reprints May Reveal Some Big Clues About SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY's Plot
item.description: Marvel Comics is reprinting a couple of key titles this summer, both of which have seemingly inspired Marvel Studios and Sony Pictures' Spider-Man: Brand New Day.

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumor Reveals The Name Of Steve Rogers' Child And It's A Possible Spoiler
item.description: According to a wild new Avengers: Doomsday rumour, there may be more to Steve Rogers' child than meets the eye, as their name connects them to a deep-cut Marvel character.

item.title: BIOSHOCK: Gore Verbinski Reflects On The "Hard R" Adaptation Universal Didn't Want To Make
item.description: Doing the rounds to promote Good Luck, Have Fun, Don't Die, filmmaker Gore Verbinski has revealed what his $200 million R-rated adaptation of BioShock was going to look like.

item.title: GOD OF WAR TV Series Has Finally Found Kratos' Son, Atreus
item.description: The cast of the God of War TV series continues to expand, with a young actor now found to take on the role of Atreus, Kratos' loyal—and mysterious—ten-year-old son.

item.title: HIGHLANDER Set Photos Reveal Dave Bautista As The Kurgan And More Of Henry Cavill's Connor MacLeod
item.description: The latest photos from the set of Chad Stahelski's Highlander reboot show us more of Henry Cavill's Connor MacLeod and finally reveal Dave Bautista as the villainous Kurgan.

item.title: X-MEN: THE ANIMATED SERIES - Mondo Unveils First Look At 1/6 Scale Limited Edition Beast Figure
item.description: The latest addition to Mondo's highly sought-after wave of 1/6 scale X-Men: The Animated Series figures is Hank McCoy, aka the brilliant, bouncing blue Beast...
